We are partnering with a large and complex organisation to recruit an experienced  Advancement Services Manager  to lead policy, governance and operational improvement initiatives within a high-performing services function. 
     
 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a policy and governance professional with a strong operational background who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, drive change and deliver practical business outcomes. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Lead the development, review and implementation of policy, governance and operating frameworks. 
 Drive strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective governance and stakeholder alignment. 
 Prepare business cases, proposals, briefing papers and recommendations for senior leadership and governance forums. 
 Assess and streamline existing processes to improve efficiency, compliance and decision-making. 
 Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to implement change and drive organisational outcomes. 
 Ensure initiatives align with established governance, compliance and technology frameworks. 
 
 Key Requirements 
 
 Demonstrated experience in policy, governance, risk, compliance, business transformation or operational excellence roles. 
 Proven ability to drive policy and governance outcomes within large, complex organisations. 
 Strong operational mindset with experience turning strategy into practical and sustainable solutions. 
 Outstanding stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple business areas. 
 Experience managing competing priorities, leading projects and delivering organisational change. 
 Strong written communication skills, including the preparation of executive papers, business cases and governance documentation. 
 Experience with project management methodologies and tools such as Asana, and exposure to enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, will be highly regarded. 
 
 This role is ideally suited to candidates from higher education, government, corporate or other highly regulated environments who have a track record of driving governance, policy and operational improvements across complex organisations.

We are partnering with a prominent Australian construction company seeking an engaging and adaptable People & Culture Manager to join their growing team. 
 This is an exceptional opportunity for a well-rounded HR generalist to balance team leadership, end-to-end operational excellence, and high-impact strategic initiatives during a period of exciting business growth and transformation. 
 
  The Role  
 Reporting directly to the Head of People & Culture, you will lead a dedicated team of 2 (expanding to 3) while serving as a key operational pillar for the business. You will work alongside the Head of P&C to drive critical strategic projects that directly shape the employee experience and organisational maturity. 
 
  Team Leadership & Operations:  Lead, coach, and develop a growing P&C team, fostering a supportive environment and ensuring smooth, efficient HR service delivery across the business. 
  Strategic HR Projects:  Partner with the Head of P&C to deliver core strategic initiatives, including the roll-out of a compelling EVP, HRIS integration, performance frameworks, and succession planning. 
  Employee Relations & Compliance:  Apply your strong understanding of Australian employment law to ensure robust compliance, practical risk management, and sound HR process governance. 
  Generalist Delivery:  Oversee the end-to-end employee lifecycle across your Head Office portfolio, partnering with leaders and offering pragmatic advice and support across performance management, talent retention, and employee engagement. 
  Change Guidance:  Support business leaders through ongoing change and scaling, translating high-level strategy into practical, business-aligned P&C solutions. 
 
  About You  
 You are a seasoned P&C Manager or Senior HR Business Partner looking to step into a leadership role. who brings a strong technical foundation in HR processes, and Australian workplace legislation. You bring excellent partnering experience and are able to build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

Henderson, WA, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 20/07/2026 to 17/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17370
- Metal Fabricators/Fitters, Construction Estimator + Structural Engineer
- Full time opportunities available
- Join the Rimech Engineering team in Henderson

At Rimech Engineering Pty Ltd, we deliver turnkey Structural, Mechanical, and Piping (SMP) solutions across Western Australia with a strong foundation built on ISO-aligned compliance and data-driven project management.

Rimech Engineering are currently looking to fill the following roles:
- Metal Fabricators / Fitters
- Construction Estimator
- Structural Engineer

Metal Fabricators/Fitters: To be considered for this opportunity, you will need to hold relevant trade qualifications and a minimum of 2 years' experience as a Metal Fabricator/Fitter.

You will also demonstrate the following tickets / experience:
- Construction Safety Awareness - White Card
- Emergency Evacuation Drill
- Water Corporation Field Based Work Induction
- Water Corporation Level 1 Lock out Tag out (LOTO)
- RIO Tinto Inductions
- Fire extinguisher training
- SWMS & JSEA Training
- Manual Handling
- Hazardous Materials
- Spill Response

You will be responsible for undertaking work as directed by the Workshop or Site Supervisor, including:
- Receive job brief from Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Undertake welding to meet the technical requirements
- Report technical problems to Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Report safety issues to Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Participate in staff safety meetings
- HSEQ involvement and adherence
- Maintain high standard of housekeeping in workshop
- Work as directed by Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Obtain tools/consumables/equipment from store to complete jobs

Construction Estimator: To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum of three years estimating experience.

You will also need to have:
- Ability to read, understand and interpret engineering drawings and project documents
- A great communicator able to engage with internal and external stakeholders
- Australian working rights

You will be responsible for:
- Keeping up to date with upcoming tenders and other significant projects
- Assess the viability of projects prior to bid
- Understand client's requirements, standards and specifications
- Perform detailed take-off's of materials
- Apply accurate costing to bids as per company templates
- Follow up on submitted tenders
- Assist with procurement and handover to project management staff
- Scope of works planning and finding cost efficiencies
- Provide advice as per contract documents

Structural Engineer: To be considered for this position, you will need to have a relevant Degree in Engineering Civil or Mechanical, and proven experience working in a similar role.

Responsibilities will include but will not be limited to:
- Receive job briefing from the Project Manager
- Brief workers of work and safety requirements
- Ensure that all plant/equipment is available for the job and fit for purpose
- Supervise workers and ensure that the work performed meets quality, technical and safety requirements
- Resolve onsite problems where they are within your capabilities and authority
- Work cooperatively with the client/ super representative
- Report daily progress, resources and problems to the Project Manager (including HSE reporting requirements)
- Ensure that client requirements are met
- Inform the Project Manager of potential job variations
- Create and update look ahead programs
- Participate in job debrief (if requested by the Project Manager)
- HSEQ involvement and adherence e.g. prestart meetings, tool box meetings, risk assessments, site inspections / audits
- Develop Management Plans & HSE documentation as required
- Develop Design and Shop Drawings. Auto CAD or similar
- Compile and maintain currency of project Quality documentation
- Assist with job progress claims & variation proposals

Remuneration packages between $78,000 - $100,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17370.php

Drive Production Excellence in a Growing Manufacturing Business 
 Supportive Team | Ownership & Autonomy | Real Career Growth 
 Are you an experienced Production Planner who thrives on keeping manufacturing operations running efficiently? Do you enjoy balancing customer expectations, production capacity, and operational priorities to deliver exceptional outcomes? 
 Our client is a well-established and highly respected Australian manufacturer of premium aluminium windows and doors, supplying customised solutions to both residential and commercial construction projects. 
 This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of production planning within a growing business where your expertise will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational performance, and on-time delivery. Working closely with the Operations Manager, production team, customers, and installation contractors, you'll play a critical role in ensuring projects move seamlessly from order through to installation. 
 If you're proactive, highly organised, and enjoy solving problems in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you. 
 What's on Offer 
 
 Join a well-established Australian manufacturing business with an excellent industry reputation. 
 Take ownership of the production planning function and make a genuine impact. 
 Supportive leadership team that values collaboration and continuous improvement. 
 Opportunity to influence operational performance and process improvements. 
 Stable, long-term career opportunity with room for professional growth. 
 Work in a dynamic and fast-paced manufacturing environment where no two days are the same. 
 
 About the Role 
 As the Production Planner, you will be responsible for coordinating production schedules, monitoring workflow, and ensuring manufacturing activities align with customer requirements, factory capacity, and delivery commitments. 
 You will act as the central point of communication between customers, production teams, subcontractors, and management, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and to the highest standard. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Production Planning & Scheduling 
 
 Develop and maintain the master production schedule. 
 Coordinate production activities based on customer demand, labour availability, material supply, and manufacturing capacity. 
 Prioritise workloads to maximise efficiency and ensure on-time delivery. 
 
 Production Coordination & Delivery 
 
 Manage work-in-progress through the Alspec V6 / APS MRP system. 
 Coordinate production, freight, deliveries, and installation schedules. 
 Monitor order progress and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts. 
 
 Customer & Stakeholder Communication 
 
 Serve as the key point of contact between customers, production teams, subcontractors, and management. 
 Provide accurate updates regarding production progress, lead times, and delivery schedules. 
 Build strong working relationships across internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Performance Monitoring 
 
 Monitor key operational KPIs including DIFOT, production capacity, and workflow efficiency. 
 Identify potential bottlenecks, production risks, and scheduling constraints. 
 Implement practical solutions to minimise delays and maximise productivity. 
 
 Continuous Improvement 
 
 Identify opportunities to improve production planning processes and workflow efficiency. 
 Support operational initiatives that enhance productivity, communication, and customer outcomes. 
 Provide additional operational coordination and administrative support as required. 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will bring: 
 
 Previous experience in Production Planning, Scheduling, Manufacturing Coordination, or a similar role. 
 Experience working within a made-to-order manufacturing environment. 
 Strong understanding of aluminium fabrication, manufacturing processes, or related production environments. 
 Experience using  Alspec V6  is essential. 
 Experience with ERP/MRP systems. 
 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills will be highly regarded. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Excellent organisational and time management abilities. 
 Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 A proactive, hands-on approach with a continuous improvement mindset. 
 Previous leadership or supervisory experience will be viewed favourably. 
 
 Why Apply? 
 This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business that genuinely values quality, teamwork, and operational excellence. You'll have the autonomy to influence production outcomes, work alongside experienced professionals, and contribute to the continued growth and success of a respected Australian manufacturer. 
 If you're ready to take ownership of production planning and play a vital role in delivering exceptional customer outcomes, we'd love to hear from you. 
  Apply now to take the next step in your manufacturing career.
